description.zh: 目录ID。可设置一个或多个。
description.en: The directory IDs. You can specify one or more directory IDs.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: 已存在云电脑的目录或已被云电脑使用的目录不允许删除。
descriptions.en: You cannot delete a directory that has a cloud computer or is used by a cloud computer.
